title: Good idea but not for those living outside of California

KptnCook sounded like a great idea but I found the app lacking as it seems to be designed for people in California (they base the market prices and availability off of cosco and whole foods) who can go to the grocery store daily. I think I'm most likely in the norm being a person that only goes grocery shopping once a week so being able to see only one day at a time really limits what I can do. Also in the small town I live in we have none of the grocery stores they list (we don't even have a organic foods store) so if you don't live in a big city the app is probably not for you. title: Would be 5 stars but…
body: I would rate this app with 5 stars but it has a couple annoying flaws. First, the extremely useful “I don’t eat” feature doesn’t actually work. Despite adding a few ingredients to that list in my profile, the daily recipes continue not just to include those ingredients, but to feature them as the main element to the recipe(s). It wouldn’t be a problem except with only 3 recipes offered per day, it becomes problematic when 2 of them regularly include an unwanted ingredient. Second, the app doesn’t seem to sync completely between devices even though I use the same login. For example, on my iPad it shows all 5 of the recipe collections I’ve made but on my phone it only shows 3, and the chosen meal plan doesn’t show up on both devices either. That said, I absolutely love the simplicity of the app (the parts that work) and the recipe layouts and photos. It’s really great that there is a portion calculator which automatically changes the ingredient quantities to match the number of portions wanted. I also really enjoy the variety of recipes offered. Although my husband and I are omnivores, I like being able to plan out the week with a majority of vegetarian dishes so I can limit our meat consumption.

title: Great app for busy people who want honest homemade food!
body: This app is one of my favorite apps when it comes to introducing easy to make recipes from mostly scratch ingredients. The photography makes this cooking app feel like a visual treat when you are looking at what you can learn to create next. Here is what I love about the app: 1. Limits the recipes you see per day and week so you don’t spend too much time scrolling through the recipes just to feel overwhelmed. 2. The photography is beautiful and captivating. 3. The recipes are easy and mostly from scratch. Easy enough for a beginner and complex enough to keep a home expert fresh on technique and beautiful recipes. 4. The ability to automatically calculate the amount of ingredients needed within the app makes grocery shopping way easier. 5. Gathering your favorite recipes is easy to make into a weekly plan as well! I highly recommend this app to anyone but especially to those who want to improve their cooking skills or to add beautiful meals to their cooking library.
